title: Uniform curve-shortening width convergence near any irrational direction for geodesics of a Finsler two-torus without conjugate points
author: Elie Nakhlé and Stéphane Sabourau
work: Deforming a Finsler metric on the two-torus to a flat Finsler metric
source_version: Official published version, Annales Henri Lebesgue 7 (2024), 1131-1174, 10.5802/ahl.217
difficulty_reason: The authors combine uniform graphical curvature control with quantitative irrational lattice recurrence and an ordered integral-translate barrier argument to shrink every geodesic in a whole neighborhood of directions. The uniform geometric-flow conclusion and barrier construction are beyond qualification differential geometry.
